With edge 1 already absent, removing edge 0 cuts the main feature path, as in runs 114, 144 and 75.
Replacing a 1x1 conv on edge 5 with pooling consistently hurt in runs 197, 216, 229 and 232.
Adding a 3x3 conv where edge 2 was absent gave gains in runs 23, 47 and 106, larger than the near-zero changes when swapping existing ops.
Adding a conv where edge 5 was absent gave large gains in runs 58, 91 and 241, larger than changes when replacing an existing op.
